title: Products bought together
statementMd:
Find pairs of different products that appear in the same order. List each pair once (smaller product id first) together with the number of orders that contain both.

Expected columns: `product_a`, `product_b`, `together`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.product_id AS product_a, b.product_id AS product_b, COUNT(*) AS together FROM order_items a JOIN order_items b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
